name: dev-guardian
description: All-in-one open-source plugin for security, bugfix, code quality, observability and compliance in dev projects. Auto-detects the stack (Node, Python, PHP, Go, Rust, Ruby, Java) and installs/configures open-source tools like Semgrep, Trivy, gitleaks, Renovate, OWASP ZAP, Playwright. Pragmatic by default, paranoid when critical. Works in EN and PT. // Plugin all-in-one open-source para segurança, bugfix, qualidade, observability e compliance em projetos de desenvolvimento. Deteta automaticamente o stack e instala/configura ferramentas open-source. Pragmático por defeito, paranoid quando crítico.
